privacy.broad_windows_style_classification: All broad candidates were TeX notation or truncated TeX context, not Windows file paths.

pdf.checks: Extractable text on every page, document metadata, XML metadata, embedded-file inventory, and final SHA256 stability. No OCR claim.

french_source_scope.classification: Only two required macro preambles match supplied French files; no complete French book source was found among selected files. Inherited credit documentation and bounded comparison excerpts remain authorized.
french_source_scope.historical_records: The 24 restored historical paths were included after sanitization; no paths remain deferred.

resolved_observation.kind: nonpersonal TeX installation path residues in wrapped build logs
resolved_observation.resolution: Root sanitized all 14 logs; this audit rechecked paths and final hashes. Build warning, page and overfull counts were preserved by the separate final log sanitization record.

limitations: Pattern scanning and source-file comparisons are scoped to the actual selected payload. They do not assert a semantic privacy proof for all imaginable encodings.
PDF text and metadata were inspected; PNG samples were inventoried, not subjected to OCR.
Mathematical formulas, proofs, and editorial correctness are outside this privacy audit.
writes: Only these two audit reports were created by this final audit; corpus, readers, PDFs, README and merge code were not modified.
